compare_nutrient_standards

Compare one nutrient across 2-3 standards, e.g.
standards='AAFCO_2024,FEDIAF_2025' (bare codes 'AAFCO,FEDIAF' = latest

tools.name: search_pet_recalls
tools.description:
Search pet-food recall / enforcement data (FDA + EU RASFF + CN enforcement).

brand: brand/product keyword, e.g. 'diamond'; reason: hazard keyword, e.g.
'salmonella', 'aflatoxin'; year: e.g. 2025. Returns summary excerpts
traceable via topic_id (full detail via get_topic_context).

tools.name: get_ade_stats
tools.description:
FDA animal-drug adverse-event (ADE) stats per active ingredient
(openFDA CVM report database, 68 compiled ingredients).

ingredient: active-ingredient name or substring, e.g. 'afoxolaner',
'carprofen', 'fluralaner'. species: optional filter, e.g. 'Dog', 'Cat',
'Horse' — restricts to ingredients repo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_topic_context, get_nutrient_value · Private data: get_topic_context, get_ade_stats · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_topic_context, get_nutrient_value · Private data: get_topic_context, get_ade_stats · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
